## Description

Please provide a summary of the changes made and the motivation/context behind them.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement / token optimization
- [ ] CI/CD or tooling enhancement

## How Has This Been Tested?

Please describe the tests and commands you ran to verify your changes:

- [ ] `python -m pytest -v` (All automated unit tests pass)
- [ ] `python -m ruff check living_docs tests` (Code conforms to linting rules)
- [ ] `python -m living_docs benchmark` (Token savings verified)
- [ ] `python -m living_docs eval` (Agent evaluation harness passes)
- [ ] `python -m living_docs conformance` (MCP protocol conformance passes)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
